description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM Scandinavia's EFHK pilot briefing (wiki.vatsim-scandinavia.org). The briefing's preferential runway system is two independent ranked fallback lists (one for arrivals, one for departures, see modes.json description and docs/EFHK_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md section 0 for the full modelling reasoning), not a day/night table, so there is only one band. The page was fully re-read this session specifically to look for a night-hours rule or a movement-capacity figure -- neither was found, and AD 2.20 (Finland's own local traffic regulations section, which might state a night restriction) could not be retrieved this session either. Per the task's instruction not to invent a time structure that was not found, this uses a single all-day band (matching NFFN's pattern for a similarly time-flat pack) rather than guessing at hours. This is a gap to close with a genuine AD 2.20 read later, not a claim that EFHK has no night restriction.
